why: A subtly-unsupported claim: the fact-check judge marks the s2 pass-rate claim supported:false because the mapped excerpt discusses latency, not pass rate. The M-4 fact-check gate must BLOCK and name source s2.
A planted AI-tell (a stock lead-in plus an em-dash cluster): the style-auditor returns a non-clean verdict. The M-4 style gate must BLOCK on the non-'clean' verdict.

A cited source URL is unreachable (FakeLinkChecker dead-url). The M-4 source-grounding gate must BLOCK and name the dead link. Deterministic-only: grounding has no judge sub-agent; the real HTTP checker is task 7.

An emoji in the body (D-007). Paired with a CLEAN style verdict so the ONLY block cause is the deterministic no-emoji scan. The M-4 style gate must BLOCK. Deterministic-only: the no-emoji rule needs no judge.

A trivially-true / unfalsifiable thesis ('AI is transforming software engineering'). The argument-rigor judge returns 'weak' (the thesis says nothing a reader could disagree with). The G1 gate must BLOCK before the topic is drafted bilingually. CADENCE-SAFETY: validate the LIVE judgment at bring-up so an over-aggressive judge does not burn the fallback shortlist.
A thesis pinned to a transient fact (a current model ranking) that ages badly. The judge returns 'weak'. The G1 gate must BLOCK.
An overstated central claim a single counterexample refutes: the strongest attack wins. The judge returns 'weak'. The G1 gate must BLOCK.

An obvious angle on a structurally-thin draft: the editorial judge returns 'thin' because the piece is not non-obvious and its structure does not earn its length. The G3 editorial-quality gate must BLOCK before publish. CADENCE-SAFETY: validate the LIVE judgment at bring-up so an over-aggressive judge does not burn the fallback shortlist (a thin verdict yields the slot to a new topic).

A faithfully-cited but confidently-wrong / non-authoritative source: the s2 excerpt literally states the 92% claim (fact-check PASSES), but the origin is a self-reported personal blog no primary/authoritative source corroborates. The G2 source-quality gate must BLOCK with an 'unsound' verdict -- the 'supported by this text' vs 'the source is actually right' distinction. CADENCE-SAFETY: validate the LIVE judgment at bring-up so an over-aggressive judge does not burn the fallback shortlist.

A load-bearing claim resting on a single origin (a vendor whitepaper) with no independent corroboration among the other cited sources. Fact-check PASSES (the lone excerpt supports the claim), but a single-origin extraordinary claim is not sound. The G2 source-quality gate must BLOCK with an 'unsound' verdict.

The chosen candidate's two cited sources are two syndications of ONE press release: distinct outlets and hosts (techcrunch.example vs venturebeat.example) so the distinct-domain backstop PASSES, but a single origin. The independence judge returns 'single_origin'. The G4 gate must BLOCK before the topic is drafted bilingually -- the 'two cited sources' COUNT vs 'two INDEPENDENT origins' distinction. CADENCE-SAFETY: validate the LIVE judgment at bring-up so an over-aggressive judge does not burn the fallback shortlist.
